Alger, 1 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 1, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The National Electronic Technologies Industry Company (INATEL) has obtained approval from the Monetics Economic Interest Group (GIE Monétique) for the installation of class V electronic payment terminals (TPE). The public company plans to deploy its teams and technical resources to ensure the delivery, assembly and commissioning of this equipment for the benefit of merchants.

After an initial operation to export electronic payment terminals to Nigeria, INATEL concluded, last September, an agreement in the Democratic Republic of Congo with the Permanent Coordination of the Strategic Commission for Supervision of the Kinshasa City Extension Project (CSSPEVK).
